title: Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

reading.body:
A self-driving car operated by Avride struck and killed a duck in a Austin neighborhood while operating in autonomous mode with a human safety operator present. The vehicle did not slow down or stop. The duck had been nesting near a local restaurant and was known to residents, which heightened community concern about autonomous vehicle safety.

This is a failure of the vehicle's perception or planning systems to recognize and avoid a small moving object in its path. The human safety operator, though present, did not intervene. It is not established whether the operator had time to intervene, whether the system was designed to detect ducks or other waterfowl, or whether the operator was monitoring the road at the moment of impact.

In response, Avride reviewed vehicle data and found no evidence of a separate alleged failure, then adjusted service areas and began simulation work to improve obstacle avoidance. Whether these steps will prevent similar incidents is not yet established.

Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

summary:
An autonomous vehicle operated by Avride struck and killed a mother duck in the Mueller Lake neighborhood of Austin, Texas, prompting significant community backlash. The incident occurred when the self-driving car, which was operating in autonomous mode with a human safety operator present, ran over the duck without stopping or slowing down. The duck had been nesting in a pot outside a local restaurant and was known to residents, intensifying their concerns about autonomous vehicle safety in their area.

In response to the incident, Avride has adjusted its testing operations by excluding certain streets around the lake from its service area. The company reviewed vehicle data and simulation replays and found no evidence supporting a resident's claim that the vehicle failed to stop at a stop sign. Avride is now conducting controlled simulation experiments to improve the vehicle's ability to avoid similar situations while ensuring changes do not compromise overall safety performance. Local residents have preserved the duck's eggs in an incubator.
